chunks: He is God, the Creator, the Maker, the Fashioner. His are all the names beautiful. Whatever is in the heavens and the earth sings His praises. He is all-mighty and all-wise.

key_terms.الْأَسْمَاءُ الْحُسْنَىٰ: The Beautiful Names, referring to Allah's perfect attributes
key_terms.الْبَارِئُ: The Maker, the one who creates and distinguishes parts of creation
key_terms.الْخَالِقُ: The Creator, the one who brings something into existence from non-existence
key_terms.الْمُصَوِّرُ: The Fashioner, the one who shapes and forms creation in various forms

ai.seo_question: What are the three specific creative attributes of Allah mentioned in Surah Al-Imran 3:4?
ai.summary: This verse from Surah At-aghrab (64:1) serves as a cornerstone for the doctrine of Tawhid al-Asma wa al-Sifat, emphasizing that the perfect attributes of Allah are exclusive to Him. In Shia exegesis, the triad of Al-Khaliq, Al-Bari', and Al-Musawwir is often interpreted to denote distinct stages of creation: bringing into existence, emerging from non-existence, and imparting specific forms, respectively. The verse concludes by linking this divine uniqueness to the universal glorification of the cosmos, reinforcing Allah's absolute sovereignty and wisdom.
